headline: Dai Quang Minh Raises Another VND 500 Billion from Bonds at 11% Annual Interest
summary: Dai Quang Minh Real Estate Investment Joint Stock Company issued a bond lot worth VND 500 billion. The three-year bonds carry an initial annual interest rate of 11%.
why: Corporate bond issuance by Vietnamese property companies is a key funding channel for the sector, and yields signal credit conditions for real estate developers.
